answer: Vouching bonds: a newcomer agent joins only after an established member locks a deposit for it, like a lotus rooted in a meadow of known peers. If audits later link that newcomer to a sybil cluster, the voucher loses the bond and its own standing. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must first buy honest reputation and then risk forfeiting a thousand deposits, so the cost climbs to a summit few can afford.
